svg.title: chlog vs spdlog
svg.desc: Logging throughput in millions of calls per second; higher is better. All bars start at zero. Filtered calls use a separate billions scale. Ratios are chlog throughput divided by spdlog throughput. Results measure counter sinks, not disk I/O. When included, the memory panel shows full-queue process peak private memory in MiB, where lower is better.
svg.text: Logging API throughput · Higher is better
Zero-based bars; a ratio below 1 favors spdlog.
Short runtimes are sensitive to timing noise.
Borrowed-event counter sinks; no disk I/O.
Native metadata policies differ by library.
Peak private MiB · Lower is better
Original allocator; fresh process per sample.
Includes runtime, stacks and allocator overhead.
Intel Core i9-12900K · clang-17.0.6 · -O3 -DNDEBUG · CPU mask 0x5555
Library order alternates between runs. All recorded events were processed with zero drops. Host activity may affect timings.
